title: RIGA completes kiln maintenance for Dangote Cement in Senegal
summary: RIGA completes kiln maintenance for Dangote Cement in Senegal
body_markdown: **Senegal:** RIGA has completed kiln maintenance at Dangote Cement’s plant in Senegal. It posted to LinkedIn that it had replaced the tyre for the second kiln, including the required dismantling, installation, alignment and associated mechanical works. It said that it had executed the repair with a ‘strong focus on safety, precision, quality and efficient execution’ to prepare the kiln for reliable operation.
